title: Endava Becomes Anthropic Select Partner | Endava
summary: Endava becomes an Anthropic Select Partner, helping businesses move from AI experimentation to production-ready solutions and measurable outcomes.
body_markdown:
**London, UK – Wednesday 25TH November** – Endava (NYSE: DAVA), the technology-driven business transformation group whose AI-native approach combines cutting-edge technology with deep industry expertise, today announced it has achieved Anthropic Select Partner status. This **status** recognises Endava’s **** Claude-certified expertise, enterprise **** production deployments **and** demonstrated customer outcomes.


We believe this milestone strengthens Endava’s position as an AI-native transformation partner, enhancing its ability to help enterprises modernise complex technology environments, securely deploy intelligent AI agents, and unlock measurable business value with and from AI.


While many organisations have successfully experimented with AI, turning that investment into scalable, production-ready solutions remains a significant challenge. Endava is addressing this by combining Anthropic’s Claude technology with deep industry expertise, enterprise engineering and Dava.Flow™, Endava’s AI-native engagement lifecycle, designed to support greater speed, governance, transparency and accountability across the software delivery lifecycle.


As part of its approach Endava helps its clients to use Claude alongside their existing applications, data and workflows, connecting the technology with existing systems and applying industry-specific business rules and controls.


Endava is focusing its expanded Anthropic collaboration on three strategic areas of enterprise transformation:


## Turning AI innovation into measurable business outcomes


Endava's work with[Marinus Solutions](https://marinussolutions.com/) , a technology company specialising in data intelligence for port and terminal operations, demonstrates how Claude can be applied in complex operational environments.


Together, Endava and Marinus Solutions developed *AskME Terminal Intelligence* , a conversational AI solution powered by Claude that is designed to connect operational, equipment and financial data, enabling terminal teams to access business-critical insights through natural-language questions.


Developed in under two months and prepared for production use just one month later, the solution is estimated to save approximately 200 hours per month in report preparation and data analysis, illustrating the potential for enterprise AI to support productivity improvements.


**Brian Boyle, CEO at Marinus Solutions, commented:** *“Getting the right insight from complex terminal data can be time-consuming. Working with Endava, we were able to move quickly from that challenge to a practical solution with Claude. AskME gives our teams a much simpler way to interrogate data using natural language, helping them get to the information they need faster and spend less time preparing and analysing reports.”*


**Matt Cloke, Chief Technology Officer at Endava, added:** *“The opportunity in enterprise AI has moved decisively beyond experimentation. Businesses now need partners who can help them turn AI innovation into tangible, scalable transformation and measurable commercial value. Becoming an Anthropic Select Partner recognises what our teams are already delivering and gives us a stronger foundation to take that work further.”*


As an Anthropic Select Partner, Endava plans to grow its Claude-certified team as it seeks to expand Claude deployments across its global client base, including in industries where Endava has specialist expertise, such as payments, banking, insurance, telecommunications, healthcare, mobility, retail and consumer goods. Read more about how Endava and Marinus Solutions are using Claude to turn terminal data into intelligence in the[Marinus Solutions case study](https://www.endava.com/case-studies/marinus-solutions-and-endava-turn-terminal-data-into-intelligence-with-claude) .


**About Endava**


Endava is a leading provider of next-generation technology services dedicated to enabling its clients to accelerate growth, tackle complex challenges and thrive in evolving markets. Endava is embedding AI across how we shape, build and run digital change and combining it with deep industry expertise to deliver outcomes with greater speed and confidence. This approach includes Dava.Flow™, Endava’s AI-native engagement lifecycle, which supports a continuous flow with built-in governance, traceability and transparency across the delivery lifecycle.


Endava’s clients span payments, insurance, banking and capital markets, technology, media, telecommunications, healthcare, mobility, retail and consumer goods and more. The Company’s team of more than 10,000 Endavans are helping clients break new ground across locations in Europe, the Americas, Asia Pacific and the Middle East.


Learn more at[www.endava.com](https://www.endava.com/) .
